name: UK Resilience Monitor Go-Live Risk Set
purpose: Defines the risk coverage the public MVP can claim at go-live. Coverage means at least one automated public source is configured for the domain and passes the go-live feed assurance tests.
scope: Public Risk Identification and Risk Assessment only. Organisational exposure, vulnerabilities, criticality and preparedness controls are out of scope.

authoritative_theme_basis.name: UK National Risk Register risk themes
authoritative_theme_basis.note: Used only as high-level vocabulary. This product does not reproduce or claim to apply the NRR/NSRA assessment methodology.

status_definitions.covered: At least one automated source is intended to provide live signals and must pass the go-live feed assurance tests.
status_definitions.partial: Some relevant automated coverage exists, but material geographic or risk coverage remains incomplete.
status_definitions.reference_only: A public authoritative source is identified, but no automated live integration is claimed.
status_definitions.gap: No automated source is currently claimed for this risk area.

go_live_domains.label: Flooding
go_live_domains.notes: England, Wales and Scotland have automated coverage; Northern Ireland is reference-only.

go_live_domains.label: Cyber
go_live_domains.notes: Signals are public monitoring indicators, not organisation-specific cyber alerts.

go_live_domains.label: Supply chain
go_live_domains.notes: Current coverage is strongest for food safety and recalls rather than all supply-chain disruption.

go_live_domains.label: Energy
go_live_domains.notes: Current signal is an energy-system monitoring indicator, not an outage-warning service.

go_live_domains.label: Space weather
go_live_domains.notes: International indicator relevant to UK infrastructure and technology dependencies.

go_live_domains.label: Other natural hazards
go_live_domains.notes: Current automated coverage is limited to selected earthquake signals and is not a complete UK natural-hazard service.

go_live_rule: The dashboard must not imply that a risk theme is monitored merely because it exists in the taxonomy. A theme is covered only where an automated source has passed the feed assurance gate.
known_coverage_gaps: No automated live feed currently claimed for terrorism.
No automated live feed currently claimed for state threats.
No automated live feed currently claimed for geographic and diplomatic risks.
No automated live feed currently claimed for societal risks.
No automated live feed currently claimed for conflict and instability.
Supply-chain coverage is currently strongest for food alerts rather than all supply-chain disruption.
Energy coverage is a system-monitoring indicator rather than an outage-warning feed.
Other natural-hazard coverage is not comprehensive.
